meta.title: Observatório da Avaliação da CAPES
meta.source: Validated outputs from the CAPES Evaluation Observatory analytical pipeline
meta.note: Piloto metodológico. Os resultados não devem ser generalizados para todas as áreas da CAPES.

Psicologia.context: Em 2025–2028, desaparece a diferenciação top-level de pesos entre programas Acadêmicos e Profissionais. Entre as relações 1:1 seguras, há aumentos, estabilidade e reduções.
Psicologia.note: A média assinada pequena esconde redistribuições relevantes: nos vínculos seguros há mudanças de até +20 e −35 pontos percentuais.

Química.context: A mudança central não é apenas numérica: todos os pesos top-level atuais são limiares mínimos, enquanto nos ciclos anteriores eram pesos exatos.
Química.note: Diferenças numéricas são preservadas como referência, mas não recebem linguagem direcional de aumento ou redução.

Saúde Coletiva.context: A diferenciação Acadêmico/Profissional surge no ciclo 2025–2028. Nos sete vínculos 1:1 seguros, quatro pesos aumentam e três permanecem estáveis.
Saúde Coletiva.note: Nos sete vínculos seguros e exatos não foram observadas reduções; a média assinada foi +7,14 pontos percentuais.

claims.claim: The top-level evaluation architecture was stable between 2017-2020 and 2021-2024 in the three pilot areas.
claims.evidence: Each pilot area retained 12 top-level items; no unmatched area-item IDs were detected.
claims.interpretation_limit: This concerns top-level Ficha architecture only; lower-level indicators, operational definitions, and evaluation practice may still have changed.

claims.claim: Top-level numerical weights were fully stable between 2017-2020 and 2021-2024 in the three pilot areas.
claims.interpretation_limit: The result is limited to Psicologia, Química, and Saúde Coletiva and should not yet be generalized to all CAPES areas.

claims.claim: The 2025-2028 model introduced a common structural reorganization in all three pilot areas.
claims.evidence: 12 -> 10 top-level items per area; Q1 4 -> 3, Q2 5 -> 4, Q3 3 -> 3.
claims.interpretation_limit: A lower number of top-level items does not by itself indicate less evaluative content.

claims.claim: The 12-to-10 transition cannot be described as simple deletion of two criteria.
claims.evidence: Among 12 historical items: 5 were reformulated, 4 retained, 1 absorbed, 1 redistributed below top level, and 1 split/reorganized.
claims.interpretation_limit: These classifications derive from the validated pilot semantic crosswalk; some relations required bounded lower-level evidence.

claims.claim: Weight redistribution across semantically comparable criteria was area-specific.
claims.evidence: Among seven safe one-to-one relations, Psicologia showed both increases and decreases, whereas Saúde Coletiva showed increases or unchanged exact weights.
claims.interpretation_limit: Only seven semantically safe one-to-one relations are included; complex split, consolidation, shared-target, and redistributed relations are excluded from simple item-level deltas.

claims.claim: Química changed the semantics of top-level weighting in 2025-2028.
claims.evidence: All seven safe relations changed from exact historical weights to current minimum thresholds.
claims.interpretation_limit: A transition such as 35 to >=35 or 65 to >=60 cannot be interpreted as an unchanged weight or a numeric reduction in the same sense as exact-to-exact comparisons.

claims.claim: The consolidation of historical items 1.1 and 1.2 into current item 1.1 reduced exact top-level allocation in Psicologia and Saúde Coletiva.
claims.interpretation_limit: The same directional interpretation is not valid for Química because its current value is a minimum threshold.

claims.claim: Academic/Professional differentiation changed across waves and areas rather than following one common direction.
claims.evidence: Psicologia: 2 -> 2 -> 0 differentiated items; Química: 3 -> 3 -> 2; Saúde Coletiva: 0 -> 0 -> 2.
claims.interpretation_limit: This describes differences in top-level weights/operators only, not broader distinctions between Academic and Professional evaluation procedures.

transitions.finding: Stable in all three pilot areas
transitions.quantitative_evidence: 12 -> 12 items per area; same 36 area-item combinations

transitions.finding: Common structural contraction across the three pilot areas
